# community.md skill update: #201

#201 (docs/community-route-signals). pr-freeze says FINAL at c75550766100703a11f2bafa9205011c95b214fe. Delivers: none; no Fixes line.

All six items are in the route, each as one table row or one bullet. Every claim was checked against pij-rs-api.md and the code:
1. What the daemon tells the prime and PA: PA missing or dormant and over-600k (217), compaction wake (222), idle nudge (224: never a cold wake, the prime gets an FYI, PIJ_IDLE_NUDGE=1 in the fleet), dialog stall (219). Each row says who gets it and what to do.
2. Stall checks via --limit, else default_limit: a check-in, then an escalation to the PA (else the prime). Recommended for merger-like roles.
3. pij requests and requests close --quiet. An --in-reply-to reply from the holder marks a request answered (answer_by_reply, plan 214 F68). --reply sets only how the requester hears back.
4. 600k means compact at it; never revive a large seat, spawn fresh on its handover; record the model per role. One correction to the brief: pij doesn't apply default_seat.model at spawn (nothing reads it), so the route says to pass it when spawning.
5. Close, then tmux kill-pane, until #200.
6. C33 in one line.

The route is 109 lines. Its pij-skill-check budget goes from 100 to 110, in the same PR. SKILL.md's community row names the new parts. The skill check, skill_verb_coverage and local-path-check all pass.
